name: zclass_object3d_model_ref_lerp_queue_add
description: zClass_Object3D_ModelRefLerpQueue::Add allocates and appends a model-ref lerp task, clamps the start/target model refs, handles inverted fades, computes the per-second delta, and enables lighting on the target object node.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 owner target zclass_model_ref_lerp_queue_owner matches 0x438020 with zero unmasked mismatches after 64 relocation bytes and 3 trimmed VC5 NOPs, BN size 349 bytes and VC5 size 352 bytes. The sibling ClearGlobalState authored body is 0x438000; 0x437fe4 pre-body padding and 0x437ff0 CRT initializer thunk are provider-boundary artifacts.
Binary Ninja has a known x87 flag-generation limitation at 0x4380f8 for the delta fsub; the implementation follows the assembly-level clamp/delta/invert behavior.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x438020 validates operator new(0x20), zero initialization, append into g_ModelRefLerpQueueState, task fields at offsets 0x00..0x1c, target/start clamping to 0..1, duration-zero fallback delta 99999997952.0f, negative delta inversion of target/current/delta with invertModelRef set, and final gwObject3DSetLitFlag(node, 1).

The native smoke covers a normal increasing fade and an out-of-range decreasing zero-duration fade, verifying queue head/tail/count linkage, callback fields, clamped task fields, inverted task fields, sentinel delta, and lit-flag side effects.
